description:
Review uncommitted changes in the vault, then stage and commit them.

Subcommands:
  review [--max-file-lines N] [--max-lines N] — show everything that changed since the last commit; read-only
  save --message SUBJECT [--body TEXT] [--dry-run] — stage every change in the vault and commit it

Flags:
  review: --max-file-lines max diff lines shown per file, default 150; --max-lines max lines of output overall, default 3000.
  save: --message commit subject, required, must be a single non-empty line; --body commit body, may span multiple lines; --dry-run report what would be staged and committed without changing anything.

Examples:
  ["review"]
  ["review", "--max-file-lines", "400", "--max-lines", "6000"]
  ["save", "--message", "Log SGB hours and flush buffer", "--body", "Added three time entries and ingested two actions."]
  ["save", "--message", "Add SGB thread", "--dry-run"]

Notes:
  Run `review` first and write --message from what it shows; do not commit blind.
  `save` only ever adds a commit — it never amends, rebases, resets, checks out, or pushes.
  `save` stages every change in the vault, not a subset.
  Exit 1 on: --message empty or containing a newline; the vault directory missing; the vault not being the root of its git repository; a failing git command.
